distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) reported Guangdong, Yunnan. These are literature-based reports; the mainland-China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending checklist review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Guangxi, Guizhou as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.
